import csv
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
paid_employee<- read_csv("data/wk1/paid_employee.csv")
```
import shp
```{r}
library(sf)
shape <- st_read("data/wk1/statsnz-territorial-authority-2018-generalised-SHP/territorial-authority-2018-generalised.shp")
names(shape)

```
check
```{r}
head(shape$TA2018_V1_, 10)

head(paid_employee$Area_Code, 10)

str(shape$TA2018_V1_)

str(paid_employee$Area_Code)
```
link
```{r}
shape2 <- shape%>%
  merge(.,
       paid_employee,
        by.x="TA2018_V1_", 
        by.y="Area_Code")
```
check
```{r}
shape2%>%
  head(., n=10)
```
原方法，无法准确分级，因为是快速绘图所有设置都是自动的，导致分级无效

tmap_mode("plot")
shape2 %>%
  qtm(.,fill = "pi")


先统计
```{r}
summary(shape2$`Paid employee`)
```

chatgpt新方法，能手动准确控制分级图例等
tm_shape()	先指定要绘制的图层
tm_polygons()	再设置面图层的符号化方式
```{r}
library(tmap)

tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(shape2) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "Paid employee",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      style = "quantile",
      n = 5
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Paid employee"
    )
  )
```
Export data
```{r}
shape%>% st_write(.,
  "data/wk1/Paid employee_2018_nz.gpkg",
  layer = "Newzeland_2018_paid employee",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```
让R和SQL连接，并指定要操作的geopackge
```{r}
library(readr)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),dbname="data/wk1/Paid employee_2018_nz.gpkg")
```

```{r}
library(DBI)
con %>%
  dbListTables()
```
```{r}
con %>%
  dbWriteTable(.,
               "original_csv",
               paid_employee,
               overwrite=TRUE)

con %>% 
  dbDisconnect()
```
